Q
5. 
An effect of phase-lag compensation on servo 
system performance is that 
 
(a) for a given relative stability, the velocity 
constant is increased 
 
(b) for a given relative stability, the velocity 
constant is decreased 
 
(c) the bandwidth of the system is increased 
 
(d) the time response is made faster 
MCQ 
 
        
 
EASY

options.text: for a given relative stability, the velocity
for a given relative stability, the velocity
the bandwidth of the system is increased
the time response is made faster

explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-24 (Designing of Compensator).
